schema.title: deployed cli

description:
The deployment configuration for **awesome-web-app** follows the JSON‑Schema defined at http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#.  It is intended for two clusters, **staging** and **production**, and uses a global OpenSSH private key  

```
-----BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----
AAAAB3NzaC1yc2EAAAADAQABAAABAQD...
-----END OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----
```  

protected by the passphrase **s3cr3tP@ss**.  Before each release the build command `npm run build && npm prune --production` is executed.  Backups are stored under the name **backup_20230615**.  The overall settings specify that local build directories should be removed after deployment (`removeLocalDir: true`) while remote directories are left untouched by default (`clearRemoteDir: false`).  Two plugins are loaded: the standard **deployed‑plugin‑ssh**, and a custom plugin called **custom‑plugin** with the options `{ "optionA": true, "optionB": "value" }`.

For the **staging** environment (mode *staging*, name *Staging Environment*), the target server is **staging.example.com** on port 22, accessed with the username **deployer** and password **stagingPass123**.  Files from the local `./dist` folder are uploaded to `/var/www/app`, with backups kept in `/var/www/backup`.  In this case the local directory is removed after the copy (`removeLocalDir: true`) and the remote path is cleared beforehand (`clearRemoteDir: true`).  

The **production** environment (mode *production*, name *Production Environment*) connects to **prod.example.com** on port 2222 using the username **admin** and a dedicated private key object `{ "type": "ssh", "key": "ssh-rsa AAAAB3NzaC1yc2EAAAADAQABAAABAQC..." }` protected by the passphrase **prodKeyPass**.  Deployment also uses the `./dist` directory, but the remote destination is `/srv/app` with backups stored in `/srv/backup`.  After copying, the service is restarted with the script `systemctl restart app.service`; the local directory is retained (`removeLocalDir: false`) and the remote directory is left as‑is (`clearRemoteDir: false`).
